name: delivery-board
title: Delivery board
description: A project delivery board in Tiles: client progress, a day strip that opens on today, roadmap lanes with initials avatars and a small assistant tile.

a11y.text: Client progress is a list where each item holds a role="progressbar" named by the client, with the percent as value and written as text. Roadmap lanes are sections named by the lane title, with an h3 and a list; owner avatars are role="img" with the name.
The day picker is role="group" (default label "Day") of buttons with aria-pressed; when now is set, today carries aria-current="date" and an aria-hidden dot. The assistant tile has a button.
The day buttons and the assistant button are native with a focus-visible outline.
